title: Southern Baptists and the two-thirds line
subtitle: Share of messengers voting for a constitutional amendment on women pastors, by annual meeting
caption: A change to the SBC constitution needs a two-thirds vote at two consecutive annual meetings. Two attempts fell short in 2024 and 2025; the broader 2026 amendment cleared its first vote and needs a second at the 2027 meeting.
note: Each bar is a different measure. 2023: the first vote on the Law amendment passed in New Orleans without a ballot count, so no share is charted. 2024: the Law amendment's required second vote, 5,099 of 8,298 ballots. 2025: an amendment to bar churches that affirm, appoint or employ a woman "as a pastor of any kind." 2026: the Truth and Unity Amendment, which also bars churches that let women preach on Sunday mornings; a quarter voted against. Also in June 2023, messengers upheld the removal of Saddleback Church (88.46%) and Fern Creek Baptist Church (91.85%) over women pastors.
